blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Anti-narcotics operatives seized an estimated P1.08 million worth of suspected shabu and arrested two suspects during a joint buy-bust operation in Barangay Gusa here late Monday evening. Personnel from the Regional Police Drug Enforcement Unit-10 (RPDEU-10), backed by local police units and the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA), launched the sting operation at Purok 4A Hillside at approximately 10:20 p.m. Police arrested two residents, identified by their aliases: “Allyn,” 28, whom police classified as a high-value individual, and “Boy,” 44.
